about.metaTitle: About Us - 20+ Years of Knitwear Excellence
about.metaDescription: Learn about Tahui Sweater Factory's 20+ year history in knitwear manufacturing. Shanghai-based, ISO certified, global export.
about.heroP1: For over 20 years, Tahui Sweater Factory has been a trusted partner to fashion brands worldwide. From our roots as a small knitwear workshop in Shanghai, we have grown into a modern manufacturing facility.
about.heroP2: Today, we combine traditional knitwear expertise with advanced seamless technology to deliver exceptional products for brands across Europe, North America, and Asia.
about.journeySub: From humble beginnings to industry leadership.
about.timeline2003Desc: Tahui Sweater Factory was established in Shanghai with a vision to become a leading knitwear manufacturer.
about.timeline2008Desc: Achieved our first major export milestone, establishing partnerships with European fashion brands.
about.timeline2012Desc: Made significant investment in WholeGarment seamless knitting technology.
about.timeline2016Desc: Achieved ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 certifications.
about.timeline2020Desc: Implemented comprehensive digital management systems for production tracking.
about.timeline2024Desc: Expanded to over 200 seamless knitting machines and $8.3M+ annual export volume.
about.missionP: Our mission is to be the trusted manufacturing partner that empowers fashion brands to bring their knitwear vision to life. We achieve this through commitment to quality, investment in technology, and genuine care for our partnerships.
about.visionP: We envision Tahui as the global benchmark for knitwear manufacturing excellence. A facility where cutting-edge technology meets timeless craftsmanship, where sustainability is embedded in every process.
about.valuesSub: The principles that guide our decisions and shape our culture.
about.value1Desc: We pursue excellence in every stitch, every garment, and every order.
about.value2Desc: We view every client relationship as a long-term partnership.
about.value3Desc: We continuously invest in new technologies and processes.
about.value4Desc: We are committed to ethical practices and environmental responsibility.
about.teamP1: Behind every garment is a team of dedicated professionals who take pride in their craft.
about.teamP2: We invest in our team through continuous training, safe working conditions, and opportunities for growth. Many of our team members have been with us for over a decade.
about.partnershipP: We do not just manufacture products - we build partnerships. Many of our clients have worked with us for 10+ years, growing together through changing markets and evolving collections.
about.ctaP: Join the brands that trust Tahui Sweater Factory for their knitwear manufacturing.

manufacturing.metaDescription: Discover our advanced seamless knitting technology, premium materials, and expert craftsmanship. 200+ WholeGarment machines, comprehensive QC, and digitalized production management.
manufacturing.heroP: Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility combines cutting-edge WholeGarment technology with traditional craftsmanship. With over 200 seamless knitting machines and comprehensive quality control systems, we deliver exceptional knitwear at scale.
manufacturing.techSub: We invest continuously in the latest knitting technology and digital systems to deliver superior quality.
manufacturing.tech1Desc: Our 200+ seamless knitting machines produce complete garments without side seams, offering superior comfort, reduced waste, and faster production times.
manufacturing.tech2Desc: Traditional fully fashioned construction for classic knitwear pieces, with shaped panels and precise finishing for timeless elegance.
manufacturing.tech3Desc: State-of-the-art computerized knitting systems enable complex patterns, precise gauge control, and consistent quality across large orders.
manufacturing.tech4Desc: End-to-end digital production management ensures traceability, quality control, and real-time order tracking for transparent partnerships.
manufacturing.wholegarmentP: WholeGarment technology represents the pinnacle of knitwear manufacturing, creating complete garments in a single process.
manufacturing.materialsSub: We source premium yarns from trusted suppliers worldwide.
manufacturing.techniquesSub: Beyond advanced technology, our skilled craftspeople bring traditional techniques that elevate every garment.
manufacturing.qcSub: Our comprehensive quality management system ensures consistent excellence.
manufacturing.qc1Desc: Every yarn batch tested for weight, color consistency, and quality.
manufacturing.qc2Desc: Continuous monitoring for gauge accuracy, pattern alignment, and stitch quality.
manufacturing.qc3Desc: Linking, finishing, and assembly inspected for precision and craftsmanship.
manufacturing.qc4Desc: 100% inspection against approved samples and AQL standards.
manufacturing.qc5Desc: Final quality audit and documentation review before shipping.

01.title: Incoming Material Inspection
01.description: Every yarn shipment undergoes comprehensive testing including weight verification, color matching, and visual inspection.

02.title: In-Line Quality Checks
02.description: Regular checks throughout production monitoring gauge consistency, pattern accuracy, and stitch quality.

03.title: Assembly Inspection
03.description: All linking, seaming, finishing, and trim operations inspected for workmanship quality.

04.title: Final Product Inspection
04.description: Every finished garment undergoes 100% inspection against approved samples.

05.title: AQL Sampling
05.description: Statistical sampling according to AQL standards, typically AQL 2.5 or stricter.

06.title: Pre-Shipment Audit
06.description: Final audit to verify quantities, packing quality, and documentation accuracy.

collect.title: Information We Collect

We may also automatically collect certain technical information when you visit our site (e.g., IP address, browser type, pages visited) for analytics and site improvement.
